name: Test Generation Broken - claude --print Cannot Create Files
description: The regression test generation feature (ENH-009) is non-functional. The implementation uses 'claude --print' which is a single-turn mode that cannot execute tool calls. Claude receives the prompt but cannot create test files. Additionally, PRDs should be copied to test folders for traceability.

userStories.title: Fix test generation to actually create files
userStories.description: As a developer completing a PRD, I want regression tests to actually be generated so the feature works as documented
acceptanceCriteria: run_test_generation uses a Claude mode that supports file creation (not --print)
On ALL_COMPLETE, test files are actually written to fade/tests/PRD-xxx/
TESTS_GENERATED signal is detected after successful generation
Test files are created with executable permissions

userStories.title: Copy PRD to test folder during test generation
userStories.description: As a developer reviewing regression tests, I want the original PRD preserved alongside the tests so I can understand what acceptance criteria they validate
acceptanceCriteria: When run_test_generation creates fade/tests/PRD-xxx/, it copies the source PRD JSON to that folder
Copy happens before test generation (so tests and PRD are always paired)
Original PRD file is not modified or moved

userStories.title: Skip PRD copy if already present
userStories.description: As a developer regenerating tests, I want the existing PRD preserved so manual edits are not lost
acceptanceCriteria: If fade/tests/PRD-xxx/prd.json already exists, do not overwrite it
No warning or message needed when skipping (silent skip)
Existing prd.json is never modified by test regeneration

userStories.title: Update README documentation
userStories.description: As a FADE user reading documentation, I want accurate information about test generation
acceptanceCriteria: README.md Regression Testing section mentions prd.json in test folders
Folder table includes: fade/tests/PRD-*/prd.json | Source PRD for test traceability

technicalNotes.rootCause: Line 1152 uses 'claude --print' which is single-turn and cannot create files. The prompt asks Claude to create test files, but --print mode only outputs text.
fixOptions: Option A: Use 'claude' without --print (interactive mode with tool use)
Option B: Use 'claude --dangerously-skip-permissions' for autonomous file creation
Option C: Parse --print output and write files from bash (fragile, not recommended)
considerations: Test generation needs write access to fade/tests/PRD-xxx/
Consider timeout for test generation (Claude session could hang)
PRD copy should use || true to avoid failing on edge cases
